name: Fermented-fish hotpot
summary: Lẩu mắm is the dinner Vietnam Tourism’s place page says not to leave Châu Đốc without. VnExpress says the pot is built on mắm cá chốt and mắm cá sặc, with noodles on the side. It is not the seafood hotpot in the charms chapter.
origin: Châu Đốc, on Vietnam Tourism’s place page. VnExpress on 26 Apr 2024 calls the town the kingdom of mắm and names this as the hotpot.
howToEat: Shared, in the evening. Vietnam Tourism’s place page does not print a recipe.

VnExpress on 26 Apr 2024 says the two main ferments are mắm cá chốt and mắm cá sặc. Into the pot: chả cá thác lác stuffed with chili, meats, seafood, water spinach, pumpkin blossom, kèo nèo, banana blossom, chili, and spring onion. Eat it with bún. The same article says to mix a little sweet-sour mắm me or chili mắm at the table.
The charms chapter’s shared dinner is a seafood hotpot of vegetables, mushrooms, noodles, and herbs. That is a different order. A price for either pot was not printed. Check on arrival.
where: Town tables. Vietnam Tourism does not name a street. VnExpress on 20 Oct 2023 also lists lẩu mắm among the dishes at the restaurant inside Trà Sư.
